QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] The Empress's Council
QuestInfo.0: If the Black Mage really did pry into your dream, his resurrection must be close. Go talk to #bAthena Pierce#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Athena Pierce introduces you to the Maple Alliance and suggests you meet #bCygnus#k, the Empress of Ereve and the Head of Alliance.
Go to #bEreve#k and talk to her.
QuestInfo.2: If the Black Mage really did pry into your dream, his resurrection must be close. You can't face him alone, so it's time to make some allies. Thinking you an average Explorer, Athena Pierce introduces you to the Maple Alliance and suggests you meet #bCygnus#k, the Empress of Ereve and the Head of Alliance who closely resembles the previous Empress, Aria.
